summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Gooey Mooey bakery website. Backend API tests (10/10 passed), WhatsApp links (all have ?text= parameter), Contact form submission (working), Image lazy loading (working). Found 1 issue: Menu page SEO title not updating.

integration_issues.issue: Menu page title shows 'Gooey Mooey | Premium Cakes & Desserts in Gurugram' instead of 'Menu & Prices | Gooey Mooey - Custom Cakes & Desserts'. The useEffect in MenuPage.jsx sets the title but App.js useEffect (with empty dependency array) runs on every render and overrides it.

action_items: Fix Menu page SEO title: App.js useEffect overrides MenuPage.jsx title. Solution: Remove the title setting from App.js useEffect OR add dependency array to App.js useEffect to only run once on mount, OR use a more robust solution like react-helmet
critical_code_review_comments: App.js useEffect has empty dependency array [] but still overrides page-specific titles set by child components. Consider using react-helmet or moving SEO logic to individual pages only.
seed_data_creation: Test enquiries created via pytest with TEST_ prefix
